description: This Python source file contains test cases for the QwikTemplate class and related project initialization logic within the 'universalinit' project. It includes fixtures to set up mock environments, tests for template info retrieval, project scaffolding, post-processing execution, configuration loading, and variable replacements in templates.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration data class for project parameters such as name, version, description, author, project type, output path, and additional parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration for different types of projects, such as QWIK, to distinguish project templates.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Data class containing information about how to initialize a template, including commands and environment setup details.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for initializing projects based on templates, loading configs, executing post-processing scripts, and managing the project setup lifecycle.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Provides a method to supply template files and configurations based on the template directory.

classes.name: QwikTemplate
classes.description: Represents a specific template type for Qwik applications, capable of generating initial project structure, processing templates, and providing init info.

methods.name: get_init_info
methods.description: Returns a TemplateInitInfo object with commands and environment details necessary for initializing a Qwik project.

methods.name: initialize_project
methods.description: Main method that executes the project creation process, including templating and post-processing scripts.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Static method to load project configuration from a JSON or YAML file.

methods.name: wait_for_post_process_completed
methods.description: Checks if the asynchronous post-processing step has completed successfully.
